instruction:
Make them realize it’s not a persona it’s just a pipeline

Make it run Al or run Betty  with repo Link
scope: Make Run Betty and Run Al with the repo link the primary TeamBuilding commands. Define both as pipeline steps.
Give web-only readers a direct public manifest URL and ordinary repo and PR links for Al’s evidence review.
Preserve the per-push Betty report, live PR resume contract, ZIP catalog and existing terminal and browser API methods.
validation: The JavaScript bridge contract confirms both starters, Al’s step type and the HTTP-only discovery path. Repository infrastructure and generated handoff are checked locally.
limitations: The commands select a pipeline task. Each session uses its own tools and permissions. Mitchell relays the review and gives Betty direction.
The current indexed Pole report remains PR #97. Release-asset status is recorded separately from the recoverable source commits.
next_steps: Use the short Run Betty and Run Al starters in separate chats. Both read the repository before the last Betty report.
Al follows the public links and returns a review and next prompt. Betty updates the live PR after the maintainer’s direction.
